professionalSummary: Programme manager of record for a deposit platform migration at a retail bank from 2022 to 2025, signing the programme charter and the four wave go/no-go submissions to the executive steering committee.
PgMP credential held since 2021 and current; PMP held since 2016.
Held the migration programme budget under the bank's delegated limits, with quarterly budget reports filed to the steering committee.
Directed the four project managers on the migration waves under the bank's programme method, holding weekly wave reviews and a monthly programme board.
Authored the programme boundary statement, risk register summary and hand‑over conditions submitted at each of the five programme gates.

projectsAndWorkSamples: Signed programme charter and wave go/no-go submissions.
